learning_outcomes.text: A student will understand control and programming of robots, processing signals from sensors.
He or she will experience preparation and realisation of an individual or group project with robotic technologies in a lab with the support of the teacher.

assessment_rules: Evaluation during the semester includes reports and projects. The approximate evaluation scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment is preliminary/final at 100/0.
bibliography: Robin R. Murphy: Introduction to AI Robotics, Second Edition MIT Press, 2019.
From Animals to Animats, Proceedings to conferences 1-16, 1991-2021.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
